verdict.rationale: Superset is an agent-orchestration workspace, so tagging an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate work is a fair question for it. The pack contains no evidence of @-mentioning an agent from a chat thread (Slack, GitHub, or in-app). Delegation happens through prompts, PR diff-line feedback, the CLI/SDK and the MCP server. The closest item, 'turn comments into updates' on shared designs and reports, does not show tagging an agent in a thread to discuss and delegate a bug.
